description: Check one name across up to 20 extensions, reusing shared evidence. Enrichment stops once availability is known, so premium can remain null. Partial failures keep the answers received plus retry guidance, without automatic retries. cachedOnly makes no provider calls. No selected-registrar fallback, fresh mode, prices or purchases.

cachedOnly.description: Return only existing fresh availability evidence, without provider calls, lookup admission, claims or retries. Cache misses remain Not confirmed.

name.description: One ASCII domain label without the extension, such as myproject. Price and link tools only build links from it; availability and popularity tools send the exact domain to their providers.

tlds.description: One to 20 distinct ASCII top-level extensions separated by commas, for the same name. Optional leading dots are accepted. No whole-catalog scans.

name: check_availability_batch

outcome.description: Whether this stage returned an answer, failed before confirming evidence, or is still in progress. Optional for older responses.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Suggested wait after a failed stage; never an evidence lifetime.

error.description: Partial failure: retain successful facts and wait before another explicit request. A confirmed Cloudflare-specific rate denial may continue through admitted fallback providers. Caller or shared-storage failure with no returned results uses the ordinary HTTP/MCP error envelope.

domains.description: When present, only these domains have a paused fallback.

unconfirmedDomains.description: Domains with unknown availability, not taken domains. Premium must be inspected separately even when this list is empty.

availability.description: Registration status; independent of premium classification.

checkedAt.description: Successful provider response time; null when no reliable result was obtained.

expiresAt.description: Recheck after this time; never a reservation or guarantee until expiry.

listEnrichmentComplete.description: Batch results: true when availability is known or every configured fallback stage has answered for this name. False means a later explicit request may add facts; it never means taken.

premium.description: Null means not confirmed, never standard tier.

ServiceInformation.description: Cheapest Domains identity and optional setup links, separate from upstream evidence. Does not establish client installation or provider health.

outputSchema.description: Successful results are AvailabilityBatch, the REST 200 response; results with isError: true are Error.

title: Check a name across extensions
